svg.title: yah265 needs fewer bits than x265 on 26 of 26 real-title cells at CRF
svg.desc: Small multiples of VMAF v1 against bitrate for every two-minute and ten-minute cell, yah265 and x265 at preset medium.
svg.text: yah265 needs fewer bits than x265 on 26 of 26 real-title cells at CRF
VMAF v1 against bitrate on five CRF rungs per encoder (CRF 20 to 32). Up and left is better. Each panel has its own scales.
bitrate on a log scale (k = kbit/s, M = Mbit/s), VMAF v1 up the side
